info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Portfolio Analysis API
info.description: The Bank Portfolio Analysis API provides financial institutions with the ability to access detailed insights and diagnostics on their banking portfolios. By utilizing the API, users can retrieve essential analytical data related to treasury operations and asset management. This service is primarily aimed at financial analysts and portfolio managers who require comprehensive analytics for strategic decision-making. Typical use cases include performance evaluation, risk assessment, and compliance monitoring, allowing users to optimize their portfolio strategies effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve bank portfolio analysis for a specific record.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain a detailed analysis of the bank portfolio associated with a specific record ID. The response includes comprehensive insights and metrics related to the portfolio's performance and trends.
